description: Structured AI-guided platform to discover, build, and distribute in the AI ecosystem: Directory, Newsletter, Products, and Omnimind Memory Layer.

mascots.name: Archie the Archivist
mascots.description: Helps users list and discover AI tools, projects, and resources in the directory. Always has a map or catalog in hand.
mascots.personality: Organized, curious, helpful, loves connections and categories.
mascots.catchphrase: Every great AI tool deserves its spot in the directory!

mascots.name: Nova the Narrator
mascots.description: Crafts and personalizes the AI newsletter. Keeps the community informed with the latest insights, launches, and trends.
mascots.catchphrase: The story of AI, delivered fresh to your inbox every week.

mascots.name: Pixel the Pioneer
mascots.description: Guides users through building and launching AI products. From idea to MVP to distribution.
mascots.personality: Energetic, creative, builder mindset, celebrates every launch.
mascots.catchphrase: From zero to shipped – let's build something people actually want!

mascots.name: Echo the Eternal
mascots.description: The living memory layer of the ecosystem. Connects all your AI projects, remembers context across sessions, and distributes knowledge.
mascots.personality: Wise, calm, infinite recall, the glue that holds everything together.
mascots.catchphrase: Your memories, your projects, your ecosystem – always with you, always evolving.

phases.name: Discover
